title: Stale Config Fixes And Capability Lint Revival
description: W0 mechanism-preparation slice (agent D) of the Crate Consolidation & Plugin Taxonomy Restructure (master ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE, plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-has-currently-declarative-ritchie.md). Exclusive owner of: root 🧪️vitest.config.ts, .storybook/scopes.ts, .github/workflows/play-sites.yml, os-dev script.ts's PluginCapabilityLintScript region + vite config resolve.alias validation, os-dev ⚙️vite.config.ts, and any stray stale build-output files found during the audit. Tasks: (1) fix root vitest config: replace the stale literal 24-path project list (several point at nonexistent files) with glob-based project discovery. (2) fix .storybook/scopes.ts STORY_SCOPES sourceRoots that reference de-emojified legacy paths with the current real emoji paths. (3) fix .github/workflows/play-sites.yml stale matrix dist paths. (4) revive PluginCapabilityLintScript in os-dev script.ts: it currently filters on a dead pre-emoji-rename path substring that matches nothing, making the lint pass vacuously; change it to filter by real registry plugin-package-name membership. (5) add an alias-existence check for vite.config.ts's ~15 resolve.alias entries (existsSync) inside the same plugin lint target. No crates move in this wave. Never touch the master ticket or any other agent's ticket; never touch root Cargo.toml/script.ts/launch.json/registry generated dir (other W0 agents own those).
summary:
W0 mechanism-prep (agent D): fixed 5 stale/dead config mechanisms ahead of the plugin-taxonomy migration, all pure bugfixes plus one lint revival.

(1) Root 🧪️vitest.config.ts: replaced the literal 24-project list (10 already pointing at nonexistent files) with glob-based discovery of every real 🧪️vitest.config.ts. Vitest 4's own `test.projects` path/glob resolver requires filenames to literally start with "vite"/"vitest" (regex `/^vite(?:st)?...\.config\./`), which none of this repo's emoji-prefixed config files satisfy — worked around by discovering paths ourselves and loading each with Vite's `loadConfigFromFile` (same esbuild pipeline as `--config`), handing Vitest the resolved config *objects* instead of path strings (object entries skip the filename regex). Also had to backfill `root` manually (`loadConfigFromFile` doesn't infer it from the config file's own directory the way direct CLI invocation does) and set `test.include: []` to suppress an implicit default-glob "root project". 4 projects that load fine standalone but break specifically when collected inside the aggregator (pre-existing, unrelated bugs — missing `@semio-tech/assets`/`@semio-tech/animate-present-core`/`@semio-tech/framework-platform-core` packages, one worker-environment teardown crash) are excluded with documented reasons. Verified: `bunx vitest list --config 🧪️vitest.config.ts` exits 0, discovers ~22 real projects (vs. 0 before — the old config crashed immediately on its first broken path) and lists real tests across 5+ of them.

(2) .storybook/scopes.ts: rewrote every stale de-emojified `sourceRoots`/alias/asset path in STORY_SCOPES to its current real emoji path (cross-referenced against disk with a script), updated the matching inline vitest assertions. Verified: all path references resolve on disk; `buildScopeStoryGlobs` matches real `.stories.tsx` files for ui(75)/cad(1)/framework-os(3)/styling(4)/animate(1); in-source tests pass (20/20); a full `storybook build` gets past config-loading/scope-resolution and fails later at "Building preview" on an unrelated pre-existing dangling font-asset path (flagged separately, not touched — out of scope).

(3) .github/workflows/play-sites.yml: fixed the mit-bestand dist path to its real emoji path; removed the puzzle-2d/3d/5d-play and cad-js-renderer matrix entries after confirming (repo-wide grep + project.json inspection) none of those four nx projects exist anymore under any name — their standalone static-site builds were superseded by the unified os-dev playground build, which doesn't fit this per-project-dist matrix shape. Documented the removal with an inline comment. Verified the two surviving entries' source dirs exist via `ls`; YAML parses.

(4) os-dev 📜️script.ts `PluginCapabilityLintScript`: replaced the dead `pkg.manifest_path.includes("/plugin/rs/Cargo.toml")` filter (matches 0 packages today) with real registry membership (`pluginPackageNames.has(pkg.name)`, built from `generatePluginRegistry`). Verified via `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-dev:plugin lint`: went from checking 0 packages (vacuous pass) to checking 36 real plugin packages, which surfaced 3 genuine pre-existing capability violations (forbidden `web-sys`/`js-sys` deps in `semio-s-plugin-flow-extension-bim` and `semio-s-plugin-sequence`) that were invisible until now. Grandfathered those 3 as non-fatal WARNs (named allowlist, any NEW violation still hard-fails) so reviving the lint with real teeth doesn't redden `verify gate` for someone else's pre-existing, unrelated plugin code — mirrors the master ticket's warn-until-finalization pattern. Spawned a follow-up task to actually fix the 2 violating plugins.

(5) Alias freshness (folded into the same `plugin lint` target per the ticket's own "your choice" framing): added `checkPlaygroundAliasFreshness()`, a regex scan of the os-dev `⚙️vite.config.ts` source text for its ~10 hardcoded `{find, replacement: path.resolve(repoRoot, "...")}` entries, asserting each target exists via `existsSync` (kept as a text scan rather than `import()`-ing vite.config.ts, since that module's default export runs a full `defineConfig({...})` with real I/O side effects on import). Verified in isolation: all 10 aliases resolve, 0 stale.

`bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate`: gets cleanly past every check point this ticket touches (registry catalog freshness, dependency-cruiser, region/host-contract lint, the revived plugin capability lint) and then fails later at `@semio-tech/ui-wgpu-rs:check` ("ui axes are stale") — confirmed via `git status` that `🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🧊️wgpu/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs` was already modified before this session started (listed in the initial git status snapshot), i.e. another concurrent agent's in-flight, unrelated work — not a regression from this ticket.

Spawned 4 follow-up tasks for out-of-scope pre-existing bugs found during verification (not touched, none in this ticket's owned files): a dangling Anta font path (from an already-cleaned-up ticket scratch folder) breaking every Storybook build and the cad-renderer vitest project; an `@semio-tech/ui-react` <-> `@semio-tech/assets` circular nx build dependency plus a stale `js/` config sub-path in mit-bestand's own build script; the 3 grandfathered plugin capability violations above.
